free_tier.stated: No free tier is published. The cheapest committed row in the price table is 30 Gbps committed mitigation for 3,120 USD per month; the Insurance Plan row reads Contact sales.

egress.terms: The entry plan carries 100 Mbps of clean bandwidth, about 32 TB per month at saturation (arithmetic from 100 Mbps over 30 days); the port rules carry no separate byte allowance.; ingress: tcp+udp
egress.free_allowance: The entry plan carries 100 Mbps of clean bandwidth, about 32 TB per month at saturation (arithmetic from 100 Mbps over 30 days); the port rules carry no separate byte allowance.

interface_detail: one port forwarding rule per protocol and port, batch-importable as protocol, forwarding port, origin port, origin IP
tooling: console, API (CreatePort) or the bulk import of four-field rules
chaining: an origin outside Alibaba Cloud is allowed, so a free VM elsewhere can sit behind it; only the instance price blocks it

limits.value: commitment starts at 30 Gbps mitigation with 100 Mbps clean bandwidth for 3,120 USD/month
clean bandwidth is sold in steps: 100 Mbps / 3000 QPS on the entry plan

binding_note: The price fails long before the bandwidth does.

identity_cost.detail: An Alibaba Cloud account with a payment method for a subscription instance; the mainland tier additionally requires real-name verification, which was not read.

reliability_note: all UDP is dropped until a UDP port rule exists, and the instance blocks reflection ports by default (17, 19, 69, 111, 123, 137, 161, 389, 1194, 1900, 3389, 3702, 11211); 1194 means an OpenVPN listener must move, WireGuard's 51820 is unaffected
confidence_note: UDP forwarding, the non-Alibaba origin, the default UDP drop and the 3,120 USD entry row are each quoted from pages read today. A cheaper mainland Pro tier may exist; it was not read.

evidence.proved: Forwarding Protocol: Select the protocol for traffic forwarding. Valid values are TCP and UDP. The Origin can be an Alibaba Cloud service or a service not hosted on Alibaba Cloud.
Anti-DDoS Proxy drops all UDP traffic by default; it blocks a default list of reflection ports including 123, 161, 389, 1194 and 3389
30 Gbps committed mitigation / 300 Gbps burst / 100 Mbps / 3000 QPS at 3,120 USD per month

notes: The product is Spectrum-class in shape and enterprise in price: the cheapest published row is 3,120 USD/month against Gcore's EUR 17. The UDP default-drop and the 1194 block are the two operational traps. Whether a free trial instance exists was not established.

extras.wg_detail: Port forwarding rules take 'Valid values are TCP and UDP', so a WireGuard datagram is forwarded to an origin that need not be an Alibaba Cloud host.
extras.volume_stated: The entry plan carries 100 Mbps of clean bandwidth, about 32 TB per month at saturation (arithmetic from 100 Mbps over 30 days); the port rules carry no separate byte allowance.
extras.transit_note: Alibaba's scrubbing centres carry clean traffic back to the origin
